facts.why: The film never mentions Angel's family or a Christmas pudding; on Christmas Day Angel and Collins visit the loft bearing gifts, so the note now says that.
facts.fix: The wobbly coconut pudding, a gift for the loft on Christmas Day
facts.full: The wobbly coconut pudding Angel's family makes every Christmas

facts.text: Tonight only, free entry, bring a blanket
facts.why: The film opens on Christmas Eve 1989, but Maureen's protest is staged after Christmas Day, not on Christmas Eve.
facts.fix: The day after Christmas, free entry, bring a blanket
